subject: prd/prd-review
statement: The reviewer shall generate candidate findings through four parallel lenses — contract quality (incl. §5.9 eval adequacy), coherence, upstream alignment (vision · principles · **incidents** · sibling-PRD overlap · record-fed basis fidelity), and the completeness critic (incl. cost consciousness) — each candidate tagged with its lens.
fit_criterion: seeded per-lens defects are each caught by their lens on the fixture corpus (EVAL-6)
